author: LowKeyMax
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network, please include the following: 

5ivee, and my previous name was Sketchz
Ok, this is a mouthful yet here I go.
Me and my twin sister share the same computer and both enjoy playing on minecraft.
I was showing her avicus when she was bored and thought the server was stupid, and easy to hack.
She began hacking using a hacked client she had got from a youtube video.
After that she got banned for flying, and ban evasion.
Yet, the next day when I went to go play on the server, apparently I was banned.
It makes no absolute sense how she was the one hacking yet we were both banned.
I have waited atleast 2 months to be unbanned and I think now was the best time to post it.

I should be unbanned because, I enjoyed playing on the server with my friends while we were in a skype call, until I got banned and we couldn't play because we enjoyed playing together, instead of alone.



Yes, my tempban / ban was partially false, because MidnightBeats should've banned her instead of our internet's Ip adress.

Yes, I can take a video of me logging onto her account, and then showing that she was banned, then go onto my account where it would only say that I was banned aswell for ban evasion.

Yes, in a matter of fact I have been waiting atleast two months to be unbanned until I realized I need to have fun on that server again.

No, because I have never ban evaded.

No, I have not appealed a ban before because I have barely been banned from any servers because I am responsible.
Thank you, 5ivee and/or Sketchz.
